question: What is the percentage of players that are under 180 cm who have an overall strength of more than 70?
evidence: percentage refers to DIVIDE(COUNT(height < 180 AND overall_rating > 70),COUNT(id)) * 100
clarification: Count each distinct id only once.
gold: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN t2.overall_rating > 70 THEN t1.id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT t1.id) AS percent FROM Player AS t1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id WHERE t1.height < 180
gold0: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN t2.overall_rating > 70 THEN t1.id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(t1.id) percent FROM Player AS t1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id WHERE t1.height < 180

c.request:
What is the percentage of players that are under 180 cm who have an overall strength of more than 70?
Evidence: percentage refers to DIVIDE(COUNT(height < 180 AND overall_rating > 70),COUNT(id)) * 100
Count each distinct id only once.
c.sql: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.height < 180 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Player_Attributes pa WHERE pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id AND pa.overall_rating > 70) THEN p.id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS percentage FROM Player p

d.request: What percentage of distinct players, counting each ID only once, are under 180 cm tall and have an overall strength greater than 70?
d.sql: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.height < 180 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Player_Attributes pa WHERE pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id AND pa.strength > 70) THEN p.player_api_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT p.player_api_id), 0) AS percentage FROM Player p;

b.request: What percentage of all distinct players are under 180 cm tall and have an overall rating above 70, counting each player once?
b.sql: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN p.height < 180 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Player_Attributes pa WHERE pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id AND pa.overall_rating > 70) THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS percentage FROM Player p;
